title: Snowflakes 25-Pack – Decoration for Garage Door, Windows and Door
seo_title: Snowflakes 25-Pack – Decoration for Windows and Door
seo_description: 25 snowflakes in white, blue and silver, 4.1 × 5.0 cm. Decorate your garage door, windows and front door in the same winter style.
descriptionHtml:
The front of the house looks bare even though the snow is already here

The garage door, the windows and the front door are big empty surfaces until the winter decorations are up. Last year's bag has either been thrown out, is broken, or is still at someone's house and you can't remember whose. Making an extra trip to the store for a bag of snowflakes feels unnecessary in the middle of everything else.

25 snowflakes are enough for garage door, windows and door

The pack contains 25 snowflakes in white, blue and silver, each 4.1 × 5.0 cm – enough to decorate the garage door, the windows and the front door in the same style.

Features

  • 25 snowflakes in one pack – enough for garage door, windows and front door in the same style.
  • Three winter shades in one bag – white, blue and silver mixed exactly where you want them.
  • Small size, big area to fill – 25 flakes of 4.1 × 5.0 cm cover more places than a single large decoration.
  • Same style on garage door, windows and door – the whole front of the house gets a unified winter feel instead of mismatched solutions.

The lifestyle images are AI-generated illustrations.

Change of mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
